entities.name: Alfred M. Gray Jr.

entities.summary: Alfred Mason Gray Jr. was a United States Marine Corps four-star general who served as the 29th commandant of the Marine Corps from July 1, 1987, until his retirement on June 30, 1991, after 41 years of service.
